description: Mint a device key for a non-browser client of the app (script, extension, phone app). The key is returned ONCE: store it in the device's local config or secret store, never in browser code or a repo. Use it as Authorization: Bearer lk_… on the data API.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

name.description: Which device or script, e.g. laptop-sync
